title: release/<build>/commands.json.gz (decompressed): the commands available_commands sends, with the console's help for each

description.description: Its language key or text, as the server sends it

help.description: What the console answers help <command>, a line each: its header, description and a usage line per overload

enums.description: Every enum a parameter may take, by name: its values (a soft enum's as the server fills them when a client joins)
